name: Gold Stars
description: Send a thoughtful thank-you after you confirm the exact preview in chat.

permissions.label: Find recipients and check allowance
permissions.description: Search shared Rolodex recipients and read your remaining Gold Stars and draft status.

permissions.label: Send confirmed gratitude
permissions.description: Stage an exact recipient, note and visibility preview; send only after you confirm the exact preview in chat. Cancel unsent drafts.

permissions.label: Mark or undo your meetings
permissions.description: Mark a Rolodex meeting as met, or undo it, only when you ask. Your own marks only.

permissions.label: Read your Skylight status
permissions.description: Read your own Skylight agent's current status and recent places. No Skylight changes.

permissions.label: Look up a resident's public profile
permissions.description: Read what another resident does, their public and village context and their social profile links. Never their email, phone, Telegram handle or private notes.
